items.name: ShellTurretTurtle
items.note: Torreta plegable: se esconde en su caparazón cerrado y saca un cuello de periscopio con cabeza-cañón (foldingSentry)
items.prompt:
Generate ONE 2D game enemy sprite for a dark fantasy mobile roguelite: a small ancient robotic turtle turret that hides inside its closed shell and extends a periscope neck with a cannon head. Side view facing right, full body, centered, SQUARE 1:1 image. One single character only: NOT a sprite sheet, no animation frames, no variations.

ART STYLE: Dark fantasy frozen cave and ice crystal theme. Cold saturated palette of deep blues, icy whites, pale blue-grey stone and frosted steel. Cyan/turquoise accents only on crystals and eyes. Painted digital illustration, stylized semi-realistic, slight texture, no grain/haze outside the character.

CHARACTER: Cracked dark-steel shell plates with pale frost-blue ice crusted on the rim, old rusted bronze rivets, a round glass-lens eye, squat and heavy, patient sentry personality. Built from packed snow, ice blocks, frost, blue-grey stone, frosted metal. It carries 1-3 glowing turquoise-cyan ice crystals: One large crystal grows from the top of the shell dome and powers it, one small crystal glows inside the cannon muzzle. It looks like it belongs to the same world as the zone's cave.

POSE (the character will be cut into separate pieces afterwards, so EVERY piece must be fully visible): calm neutral pose, not an action pose, no foreshortening. Arms held away from the torso, never crossing in front of the body and never hidden behind it. Hands, weapons and fists never cover the legs, the other arm or the head. Legs apart with a visible gap. Wings, tails and accessories spread out. No piece hides more than about 10% of another. Name sides by the image (the arm on the LEFT / RIGHT of the image).

PIECES — exactly these 3, no more (no extra arms, hands, weapons or loose parts; each piece joins its neighbour at a visible joint and has a clearly visible contour where they touch):
1. Base: the closed, solid round shell dome seen from the side, flat bottom, no opening, no mouth, no hole, the neck is NOT visible in it, with the crystal on top
2. Stem: a thin segmented steel neck like a telescopic periscope tube, drawn fully straight and vertical, separate from the shell, with a visible joint at the top and bottom
3. Head: a boxy turtle head with a short cannon snout pointing to the RIGHT of the image, one round glowing eye, small ice crust on the brow, fully visible

EDGE RULES (critical):
- Clean, crisp, hard silhouette with a 2px near-black outline all around, and a slightly darker contour line where pieces meet.
- NO glow, aura, halo, bloom, particles, snow, frost mist, dust, smoke, embers, blur or soft edges outside the outline. Crystal glow stays inside the silhouette.
- ABSOLUTELY NO effects of any kind: no energy beams, no muzzle flashes, no impact bursts, no motion lines. NO cast shadows, NO ground. A flame or glow that belongs to the body is one flat color inside its own outline.
- Background: perfectly flat, uniform pure white, zero gradient or noise, even if an attached reference image has sky or scenery. The character contains no pure white fill touching the background (use pale colors).
